استجزا (form X)
# اِسْتَجَزَّا (istajazzā) /is.ta.d͡ʒaz.zaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَجَزَّ (istajazza)
# اِسْتَجِزَّا (istajizzā) /is.ta.d͡ʒiz.zaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَجَزَّ (istajazza)
